questions.prompt: Which kingdom do bacteria belong to?
questions.explanation: Bacteria are single cells with no true nucleus, so they are Monera. Protoctista have a true nucleus.

questions.prompt: An organism has cell walls and chlorophyll and makes its own food. Which kingdom does it belong to?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll and photosynthesis are features of plants. Fungi have cell walls too, but they cannot make their own food.

questions.prompt: A mushroom reproduces by spores and cannot photosynthesise. Which kingdom does it belong to?
questions.explanation: Spores and no photosynthesis point to Fungi. A mushroom grows from the ground, but it is not a plant.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a feature of animals?
options: Their cells have no cell wall
questions.explanation: Animal cells have no cell wall. Photosynthesis belongs to plants and spores belong to fungi.

questions.prompt: Amoeba is a single cell with a true nucleus. Which kingdom does it belong to?
questions.explanation: Single cells with a true nucleus are Protoctista. Monera have no true nucleus, and animals have many cells.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between Monera and Protoctista?
options: Monera have no true nucleus, but Protoctista have a true nucleus
Monera are plants, but Protoctista are animals
Monera have many cells, but Protoctista have one cell
questions.explanation: Both are made of single cells. The difference is the nucleus: Monera have no membrane around their genetic material.
